explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/805: 'Alon and Sudakov proved that there is no such graph with g(n) = (c/log log n)(log n)³ for some constant c > 0.' The Lean statement: ∃ c > 0 such that for all large n there is no graph on Fin n that is IsLocallyRamsey with m = ⌊c·(log n)³/log log n⌋ and k = ⌈log n⌉. Natural logarithms and the floor are reasonable normalisations for an unspecified constant c. Faithful.
